request.spec:
Show a rate calendar: for each grade and each month of the sheet's today's calendar year, the
rate in force on the first day of that month (n/a when none).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Show a rate calendar: for each grade and each month of the sheet's today's calendar year, the
rate in force on the first day of that month (n/a when none).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The rate calendar is in, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 acceptance tests.

The change is front-end only, in `src/main/frontend/features/rates/rates.slot.tsx`. The rates panel now has a table with one row per grade and one column per month of the year of the sheet's today. Each cell (`rate-month-<grade>-<yyyy-mm>`) shows the rate in force on the 1st of that month, or `n/a` when there isn't one.

It reuses the existing `rateFor` function, the same one behind the "current rate" column, so the calendar resolves rates the same way the app already does:
- A rate stops applying after its to-date.
- An earlier rate doesn't come back once a later one has ended.
- Rates inherited from a parent sheet are used when the sheet has none of its own.

Nothing changed on the server or in the stored data, and the calendar writes no audit records.
